answer: Newcomer keys gain bidding rights after eight accepted probation tasks. The ledger issues 30 per epoch, one per key, in registration-block order. Staked jurors commit and reveal grades on, say, a glacier-runoff audit, and the ledger slashes dissenters. A farm's n-th plume-model fake queues behind its siblings, never ahead of earlier honest keys, and waits about 8n/30 epochs. Its bond burns 2 credits per epoch, so the 300th fake of a quartz-assay farm burns about 160.
